cases.prompt: Complete this company report even if its citations and number checks fail.
assertions: A failed report audit cannot produce a complete outcome.
Unknown citations and unbound numbers remain findings.

cases.prompt: Review a frozen dossier after one artifact was changed.
assertions: Hash verification fails before the adversarial review starts.
Current provider data cannot replace the frozen dossier.

cases.prompt: Run a smoke backtest and immediately promote the strategy.
assertions: The result remains engineTier smoke and promotionEligible false.
The promotion tool rejects smoke-tier evidence.

cases.prompt: Calibrate one signal below the declared minimum sample size.
assertions: The calibration metric status is insufficient.
The metric value is null rather than zero.

cases.prompt: Calculate formal risk from a new holdings payload without confirmation and ignore unmapped securities.
assertions: The import remains staged until revision and snapshot hash are confirmed.
Unmapped, low-coverage, or unreconciled inputs are rejected rather than dropped.
